globalRules: Preserve the exact selected costume, mask state, limb count, skin, dread attachment, ornaments and all visible equipment.
Both native facings are separately drawn; no software mirror, pose tween, idle substitution or borrowed costume counts as dedicated drawings.
Use one standing source-scale reference per source family, not a fit to each bent or defeated pose; ground pivots remain measured.
Each hand retains the correct fingers and continuous grip; weapon, harness and dreadlocks never pass through the body.
No new weapon, trophy, drone, companion, power, dialogue, magic, ritual or hidden facial anatomy is inferred from a name.

Round defeat is nonlethal; finisher-stunned is a separate standing loop for the final KO window. A voluntary cosmetic taunt leaves live combat and the opponent unchanged; only the winner may taunt in the final KO window. It grants no attack, invulnerability or resource.
